title: Tapered column from a sketch 30 up, down To Object (the box top), widening 10 degrees

expect.note: Box 40x30x10 = 12000. Column 20 tall from z=30 to the box top; it widens by 20*tan(10 deg) = 3.5265 per side going down: 10x10 at the top, b = 17.0531 square at z=10. Frustum V = h/3 (a^2 + b^2 + a b) = 20/3 (100 + 290.807 + 170.531) = 3742.2554. FreeCAD's Pad ignores a taper up to a face (it gave 14000), so SciForge builds it. Faces: box 6 (its top keeps the footprint as a hole) + 4 sloped sides + the column top = 11.
